project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to manage exam and results processing, potentially supporting features like course selection, fee calculations, and result viewing. The core architecture leverages Vue components and likely relies on a routing system for navigation. There's a distinct separation between application services, layout, and specific forms/pages. The application’s design shows a focus on user experience with potential components for displaying course information and managing user interactions.

layers.description: Handles UI rendering and user interactions.
Contains the core logic for exam management and other functionalities.

macro_trends.title: Potential Prop Drilling Concerns
macro_trends.description: Several Vue files (e.g., ApplicationServices.vue, ResultPage.vue, ExamFormSubmission.vue) are directly being navigated to via Router pushes. This suggests potential deep prop drilling and inconsistent state management.  A centralized state management solution should be investigated to improve maintainability and reduce coupling.

macro_trends.title: Centralized Logic Risks
macro_trends.description: The 'ApplicationServices' folder contains what appears to be the core business logic. While functional, this single folder represents a potential bottleneck and single point of failure. Decoupling these services into smaller, more manageable modules could enhance scalability and testability.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow begins with the user interacting with forms (e.g., ExamFormSubmission.vue), processing potentially involving data validation and storage (ApplicationServices.vue), and ultimately presenting results through the ResultPage.vue component. The key relationships rely on router navigation to transition through this process.

key_workflows.name: Time Table Retrieval Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves fetching and displaying exam time tables through the viewExamTimeTable.vue component, potentially drawing on data services (ApplicationServices.vue). The flow is largely driven by router navigation.
